create_solvent_from_atoms: create a Solvent object by passing an ase.Atoms object representing a solvent molecule
create_solvent_from_db: create a Solvent object by passing a solvent ID index to load from the solvent database pickle
get_molar_mass: get the molar mass of a Solvent object by summing atomic masses from the atoms attribute
get_molecules_per_volume: get the number of molecules per angstrom cubed by accessing the molecules_per_volume property on a Solvent
load_solvent_with_custom_density: load a Solvent from the database with a custom density value overriding the default stored density
